countries.title: Countries
countries.description: All the countries to compare, comma-separated, e.g. 'Malawi, Kenya, Rwanda, Burundi'. Pass every country the user named in a single call.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year
fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year, e.g. 2027. Defaults to the current scenario when omitted.

program.title: Program
program.description: The Headroom category / program, e.g. Core Program, Rural Retail, Trees. Pass the user's wording; the action resolves synonyms.
